messages:
Aisha (CSM): Kicking off Crest pilot onboarding. Two-week pilot, focus on embeddings for product docs + internal chat.
Priet (Crest PM): Hello! I'll be day-to-day PM. Dana is infra lead. We'll provide ~7k docs and an eval set. Main constraint: strict audit logs and SOC review.
Marco (Solutions): Noted. Proposed success criteria: ingest 7k docs; median retrieval relevance >=0.75; p95 chat latency <600ms; end-user spot-check satisfaction >=80%.
Dana (Crest Infra): We'll need VPC peering + firewall allowlist. Can provide CIDR + service account by EOD day 1. Also want syslog forwarding.
Leah (Enablement): I'll run training for agents Day 5 and an admin ops walkthrough Day 2. Who should attend from Crest?
Priet (Crest PM): Support reps Mira, Jose, and Nia for training. Security engineer Arjun for Day 2.
Aisha (CSM): Timeline: Day0 creds/discovery; Day1 networking; Day2 ingest prep + admin ops; Day3-5 ingest & index; Day6-9 tuning + spot-checks; Day10 exec demo; Day13-14 go/no-go. Agree?
Marco (Solutions): I'll post ingest sample (JSONL) and a short CLI today. Quick snippet: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --data-binary @docs.jsonl
Dana (Crest Infra): CIDR and service account posted. SIEM endpoint: https://siem.crest.internal/llm-hook.
Aisha (CSM): Action items recap: Dana: networking & SIEM (day1). Marco: ingest script + eval harness (day2). Leah: training invites (day2). Priet: upload eval set + expected answers (day2). Cost Bot: rough pilot cost posted in doc.
Cost Bot: Estimated pilot cost: Dedicated-small ~ $Y/hr + token projection attached.
Aisha (CSM): Risk note: renewal risk if adoption <40% or major incidents during pilot. Scheduling Day8 mid-pilot check and Day10 exec demo. I'll keep the board updated and tag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
